verdict.rationale: Kong, as evidenced here, is an API gateway and API management platform (Gateway, AI Gateway, Konnect, Dev Portal, Catalog). Sharing request collections in a synced team workspace is an API-client capability, so this story is outside the product's category. Nothing in the evidence shows Kong shipping collections or synced collection workspaces that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As a developer, I can share collections with my team in a synced shared workspace
